LanguageData.HMH_ShowTechWidgetTip: Overlay showing progress toward the next tech level as calculated by Ignorance Is Bliss. RMB to drag, LMB to open research. Requires Ignorance Is Bliss in "percent researched" mode.
LanguageData.HMH_ShowGuestSilverTip: Show a silver icon and the remaining shopping money above Hospitality guests. Only displayed when a guest carries more than 40 silver.
LanguageData.HMH_GuestSilverZoomTip: The silver tag is only visible when the camera is zoomed in past this threshold. 0 — always show; higher values require zooming in closer.
LanguageData.HMH_TechWidget_TipHeader: Current level per Ignorance Is Bliss: {0}\nTransition threshold: {1}% of the level's projects
LanguageData.HMH_TechWidget_TipNote: The counter is cumulative: finished projects of higher levels also count toward the target.\n\nLMB — research, RMB — drag the widget.
